161 
The courses at Nottingham Trent University, most notably the Mobile 
Applications module and Service-Centric and Cloud Computing have played a 
substantial role in honing my skills and bolstering my understanding within these 
domains. Thereby setting the foundational pillars for my future endeavours and 
successes. 
The project was specifically chosen and designed around my endless need to 
improve myself as a software engineer. Ultimately this project has taught me 
aspects of cloud and mobile development, that are abstracted away from you in 
the workplace. Such as during the cloud architectural design phase of the 
project, I learned quickly that pricing is a very important factor. Notably, the 
Virtual Private Cloud feature was something unaccounted for and resulted in an 
unexpected bill. These unique perspectives and insights have given me a 
fundamentally deeper understanding of these topics, that will hopefully help and 
guide me within my career.
